scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Install WooCommerce on an owned test site; generate keys for a permitted user.
app.surface: REST; products, orders, customers and coupons
app.note: Consumer key/secret via HTTPS Basic auth; hosting and user permissions are the operational prerequisites.
app.next_action: Run a test WordPress/WooCommerce store, create a read-only consumer key, and retrieve a seeded product over HTTPS.
app.success_criterion: Return the product while a write attempt is excluded by the key's permissions.
app.alternative_action: Prefer the public REST API; inspect plugin-specific UI calls only if a required extension field is not exposed.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
